summary: Build coaching, accountability, and performance leadership skills in 5 days. Learn OKRs, GROW, SLII, and reporting tools.
lede: Human performance leadership helps managers align team goals with practical routines for performance, coaching and change. For people managers, team leaders and HR or people operations professionals, the course covers building OKR scorecards, structuring GROW-based performance conversations, and assessing team trust and change adoption. Scenario-based exercises turn these methods into coaching plans, team agreements and reporting roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage people, performance, and change in day-to-day operations.
audience: Talent management specialists using human capital data
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 to 5 years of experience in a supervisory, team leadership, HR business partner, or operational management role. Familiarity with performance reviews, basic team reporting, and common workplace feedback processes is expected. A spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is helpful for OKR and human capital metric exercises. No coding is required, and advanced concepts such as ISO 30414 and AI-driven talent analytics are taught at an operational awareness level, not as technical engineering.
